events.title: Garden Glow
events.info: More than two million lights, projections and immersive experiences. Runs Nov 14 to Jan 2.

events.title: Weirdly Wonderful Holidays at City Museum
events.info: City Museum turns into a holiday winter wonderland. Runs Nov 19 to Jan 3.

events.title: Santa's Magical Kingdom
events.venue: Jellystone Park, next to Mid America Adventure
events.info: Drive-through or wagon-ride light show with 4 million lights. Open nightly Nov 20 to Jan 3.

events.title: Brewery Lights at Anheuser-Busch Brewery
events.info: 40th annual light display with a nightly light show and parade. Runs Nov 21 to Dec 26. Tickets tend to sell out.

events.title: Holiday Lights at Grant's Farm
events.info: Drive-through or walking light displays, Santa and the Clydesdales. Runs Nov 21 to Dec 30. Reservations recommended.

events.title: Way of Lights
events.venue: National Shrine of Our Lady of the Snows
events.info: Annual Christmas light display on the shrine grounds. Runs Nov 20 to Dec 31.

events.title: Winterfest at Kiener Plaza
events.info: Ice skating, curling, holiday market and more through Jan 3. Thu-Fri 4-8 PM, Sat-Sun 12-8 PM.

events.title: Ameren Thanks-For-Giving Parade
events.info: 42nd annual parade with floats, marching bands and Santa Claus.

events.title: Festival of Lights
events.info: Free family event opening Winterfest: performances, reindeer, Tree of Lights lighting and fireworks.

events.title: Festive Friday at the Saint Louis Art Museum
events.info: Free concerts, tours, gallery activations and art-making, 10 AM to 9 PM.

events.title: Love Actually in Concert
events.info: The film plays in full while a live orchestra performs the soundtrack.

events.title: Cirque Dreams Holidaze
events.info: Family-friendly holiday circus spectacular. Also Dec 19.

events.title: Nutcracker! Magical Christmas Ballet
events.info: Ballet, puppets and acrobatics. Also Dec 21.
